rust_summary: a crop, stem, cactus, sugar cane, bamboo, mushroom or vine growing or spreading (`native_block_grow`).
doc_summary: `native_block_grow(dimension, pos, from, to, cancel)` is asked before a growth or spread step at `pos` in `dimension`: the block changes from `from` to `to`, block names with their properties. Set `cancel` to leave it as it is. Covers crop, stem, cactus, sugar cane and bamboo growth, grass spreading onto dirt, mushroom and vine spread; not sapling trees, nether wart, sweet berries, mangrove propagules or sculk. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_grow@.
